text:
alex_dev: Heads up — platform will switch to deterministic telemetry sampling next week (hash(user_id) based). This changes how we count tokens for quota attribution when SDKs send sample weights. Could be a breaking change for older clients.

maria_platform: @sam_sdk @ellie_metrics sorry for the short notice. Plan is: add `X-RW-Sample-Weight` (float 0..1) and deprecate old `X-Redwood-Sample` header in 14 days. We want SDKs to send the new header and preserve route metadata for dashboard attribution.

sam_sdk: Do we have a migration strategy? Old SDKs might still send legacy header or nothing. If platform treats missing header as weight=1 that could blow quota.

ellie_metrics: We should avoid treating missing header as 1. Proposal: server-side fallback that infers weight=1 only for tokens from verified clients for 2 weeks, otherwise mark as un-attributed and show in dashboard. That buys time for SDK bump.

jordan_prod: Dashboard UX ask: we need a view that shows "unattributed tokens" and allows filtering by SDK version so customers can find out who needs to upgrade. Also a diff view to show per-route changes pre/post rollout.

sam_sdk: For client libraries I propose:
- minor bump for Py/Go/Ts with opt-in env var `RW_TELEMETRY_MODE=new` that sends `X-RW-Sample-Weight` and `X-RW-Route-Meta`.
- default disabled for one release; then flip default after we confirm <1% breakage in canary.

alex_dev: That sounds reasonable. Can we do deterministic sampling client-side so sample decisions are stable across retries and dedup? E.g., `hash(request_id) < sample_threshold` so weight=1 or 0 and we set sample weight header accordingly.

sam_sdk: Yes — we can ship deterministic sampling helpers in SDKs. Example snippet for Python: ```python
from rwdk import telemetry
telemetry.set_sampling(user_id, 0.02)
# sets header X-RW-Sample-Weight: 0.02 and X-RW-Sample-Decision: 1/0
```

ellie_metrics: Also recommend adding `X-RW-Sample-Decision` to convey binary decision; that helps aggregation in Prometheus and avoids fractional math in some pipelines.

maria_platform: Action items:
1) Platform: add temporary server-side fallback that labels tokens as `unattributed` rather than counting against quota for unknown header (2d)
2) DevEx/SDKs: ship opt-in SDK release with env var + helper (3d)
3) Metrics: add dashboard tile for "unattributed tokens by SDK version" and per-route diff (5d)
4) Rollout: canary 1% of traffic -> 10% -> 50% -> 100% with monitoring alerts on quota surprises (7d)

jordan_prod: For communication, we should send a deprecation email and console banner with migration guide and a curl example. e.g.:
```bash
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/generate \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $KEY" \
  -H "X-RW-Sample-Weight: 0.02" \
  -H "X-RW-Route-Meta: feature=beta;team=search" \
  -d '{"input":"hello"}'
```

sam_sdk: One more compatibility note: retries must copy the sample headers exactly, otherwise sampling shifts. We'll add test cases in the client integration suite.

ci-bot: scheduled rollouts: telemetry-sampling-v2 -> canary at 2024-06-12T18:00Z (ticket RW-5421), automatic rollback threshold 3% quota deviation.

alex_dev: Thanks team. I'll draft the console banner + migration doc. @sam_sdk please ping when opt-in builds are ready so we can start canary.

sam_sdk: Will do. I'll post the PR and changelog link once builds pass.

ellie_metrics: I'll add dashboard mockups to the ticket (RW-5421).

maria_platform: keeping this thread as the single source for coordination — update when PRs/rollout gates change. :thumbsup:
